t: You're at Park Square, a large garden square that acts as a private appendix to Regent's Park. Two facing rows of grand, stuccoed terraced houses surround it, with balconies on the lower floor and a colonnade of porticos by the architect John Nash. They were built in 1823 and 1824, and the terraces at the corners are Grade I listed too. William Salt, a banker, genealogist and antiquary, died here. The William Salt Library in Stafford was founded in his memory.
